verdict.rationale: Cactus's GitHub README says any Hugging Face model can be converted with `cactus convert [HF-Name]` and then run locally via `cactus run`, but it labels the conversion path experimental and requires a conversion step rather than direct running. Community reports show models do download and run on-device, though one user's Jan Nano/SmolLM3 GGUF downloads in the demo app crashed on selection. Missing for 10: direct no-conversion HF model loading, stable (non-experimental) conversion support, detailed docs on supported HF architectures, reliable hands-on corroboration of arbitrary HF models running.
